## Governance rules

- Add or update a row in `docs/parity/polydart-polygolem.yaml` whenever a public feature is added, removed, intentionally omitted, or safety-gated.
- Prefer local/mock tests for parity evidence. Do not use this matrix as approval for live trades, custody mutations, deployments, publishing, or secret handling.
- Generated docs must be refreshed with `node scripts/generate-parity-docs.mjs`; CI/local checks can use `node scripts/generate-parity-docs.mjs --check`.
- `partial` rows should include an explicit note explaining whether the gap is intentional, safety-gated, or still planned.
